verdict.rationale: Maritime runs each agent in its own cloud micro-VM, with secrets injected only into that agent's VM, and gives end users per-user Linux desktops. AI-driven code therefore executes on Maritime's infrastructure rather than the developer's. However, the docs never present this as a sandbox for untrusted code and make no isolation or security guarantees. missing for 10: an explicit sandboxed code-execution API for untrusted/AI-generated code, documented isolation guarantees (network and resource limits, escape protection), ephemeral run-and-discard execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute untrusted, AI-generated code without risking my own infrastructure
